name: Invoice
description: A payable invoice: what is owed, when it is due, and a single way to pay it.

origin.note: Design: ledger — document proportions, tabular figures, rule above the total.

subject: Invoice {{ invoice.number }} from {{ company.name }}
preheader: {{ invoice.total }} due {{ invoice.due_date }}. Pay online or download a copy.

heading_text.description: Document title, set small and tight like a document heading rather than a marketing headline.

body.description: One line of context above the figures. Optional; a clean invoice needs no preamble.

invoice.total.description: Formatted total, set at 40px as the largest element on the page. Format at the call site — decimal separators are not universal.

line_items.description: Line items as `label`/`value` pairs. Quantity and unit price belong in the label, since two columns survive 320px without a media query.

totals.description: Subtotal, tax and total. The last row is emphasised automatically, so put the total last.

pay_url.description: Hosted payment page. Never a permanent link — hosted invoice URLs expire.

manage_subscription_url.description: Cancellation link. Required by Stripe for FTC and California compliance on subscription billing mail.

footer_legal.description: Tax and legal footer. Varies by jurisdiction, so it is a token rather than baked into the markup.
